name: Hackathon / Salesforce PPT
description: Fills Sample_ppt.pptx from S3 using the PPT-AI simple-request pipeline.

slots.label: Team name
slots.question: Team name?
slots.help: Shown on the title slide footer across the deck.

slots.label: Problem statement ID
slots.question: Problem statement ID? (e.g. PS-014)

slots.label: Theme
slots.question: Hackathon theme? (e.g. Customer Support Automation)

slots.label: Team members
slots.question: Team members (names, separated by bullets or commas)?

slots.label: One-sentence pitch
slots.question: One sentence (max ~20 words): for whom, what you built, what changes?

slots.label: What breaks today
slots.question: What breaks today, and where exactly does it break? One bullet per line.
slots.help: Slide 2 left column — 4 pain bullets only (delay, who feels it, cost, quote). Do not describe the product here.

slots.label: What you built
slots.question: What you built, in plain language. Four bullets, one per line.
slots.help: Slide 2 right column — exactly 4 bullets: (1) what it does, (2) what the user can do, (3) when/where they use it, (4) [Insert screenshot]. Not the pain points.

slots.label: Demo URL
slots.question: Demo / recording URL?

slots.label: Demo moment
slots.question: The moment the AI does its job — timestamp it.

slots.label: Hardest input
slots.question: The hardest input you tested it against?

slots.label: User outcome
slots.question: What the user gets at the end, and how fast?

slots.label: AI decision
slots.question: Which decision or generation does the model actually make?

slots.label: Why not rules / SQL
slots.question: What could an if-else or SQL query never have done here?

slots.label: AI service & guardrails
slots.question: Service used (prompt / RAG / agent / fine-tune), PII handling, who overrides it?

slots.label: Tools used
slots.question: Tools used and for what. One bullet per line.

slots.label: Input / source
slots.question: INPUT / SOURCE component?

slots.label: Processing
slots.question: PROCESSING component?

slots.label: AI layer
slots.question: AI LAYER component?

slots.label: Output / user
slots.question: OUTPUT / USER component?

slots.label: Architecture flow
slots.question: One-line flow across those four boxes?

slots.label: Tech stack
slots.question: Front end, API, data store, AI service, hosting. One bullet per line.

slots.label: What is demoable
slots.question: Built vs mocked vs not started. One bullet per line.

slots.label: Biggest technical gap
slots.question: Biggest gap, data needed, effort to production. One bullet per line.

slots.label: What exists today
slots.question: What exists today, and what it cannot do?

slots.label: Where you win
slots.question: The one dimension you clearly win on, and why?

slots.label: Why a clone would fail
slots.question: Why a weekend clone would not match this?

slots.label: Time saved
slots.question: Hours saved / week (measured or estimated)?

slots.label: Speed / accuracy claim
slots.question: Speed or accuracy claim, and how you know?

slots.label: Reach if adopted
slots.question: Reach if adopted?

slots.label: What you need next
slots.question: What you need to take this forward?
